title: fix: retry chat initialization after rolled-back maintenance conflicts
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Chat initialization could fail before replying when concurrent subagent maintenance changed prepared facts, even though SQLite confirmed rollback. CI also exposed a pre-existing model-fallback failure: retry instructions attempted to replace an already-dispatched user prompt.

## User Impact

Known rollback conflicts recover through the existing bounded initialization retry. Model fallback retains the original user turn and frozen projection while delivering retry instructions separately. Unknown transaction outcomes, mismatched receipts, and failed native-binding compensation remain terminal. No schema, stored-data, retention, permission, configuration, dependency, or update migration changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing transaction settlement and serialized mutation-conflict owners, with the exact session-maintenance operation label. Do not add another retry owner. The prompt-state owner treats a fallback as internal continuation only when the factory-owned recorder confirms prior provider dispatch.

CI repairs preserve typed-error, native-write, resource-retirement, archive-retention, and recovery-owner assertions. Current main independently landed the earlier export cleanup and some fixture fixes. Four resulting fixture conflicts were reconciled against `a285e8ba5841732229a931b3ed230b45574e09cc`: retain nonvacuous memory resource/complete-archive proof, and keep main's equivalent recovery fixture and mock explanation. Storage repair is −5 production lines; the separately reproduced fallback repair adds 8 (combined +3 against that main).

## Evidence

- Original chat initialization regression failed with the production SQLite error before repair. Known rollback, unknown settlement, mismatched receipt, lost reply publication, native compensation, and source replacement cases now pass.
- After current-main integration, all **74 tests across seven SQLite/projection files pass**, 152.16 s serial wall. This includes 63 SQLite boundary tests and 11 prompt-projection tests against the newer database admission/transaction owners.
- Separate measured `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1` runs on the pre-integration candidate: entry-patch 25/25 in 34.60 s; lifecycle projection 16/16 in 25.83 s; agent purge 8/8 in 31.46 s; prompt projections 11/11 in 24.37 s (66.43 s in the parent, including 41.9 s compiler preparation). These existing fixtures exercise real worker transactions, receipt transport, durable projection and publication; no sleeps, polling, new Gateway fixtures or CI worker pins were added.
- Fallback regressions fail original code in both plain and previously enriched user-turn cases. The full isolated Gateway fallback suite passes **13/13 in 174.16 s**, including hidden-child and distinct direct-child ladders. Recorder/prompt/boundary siblings pass 71/71 in 57.59 s.
- CI fixture proof before integration: source-delivery 10/10 in 91.56 s; source-authority 4/4 in 14.43 s after independently reproducing the old SQL-shape assertion on the pre-PR baseline; three maintenance-error suites pass in 88.81 s. Memory suites pass 4/4 in 80.12 s, artifact API/restart/download passes in 83.36 s, interactive Doctor plus repeat/idempotence passes in 355.40 s including cold QA build. These checks used private state or network-none isolation, with cleanup confirmed.
- Production and relevant test types, typed lint, formatting, export scans, prompt snapshots, and storage/import/auth guards pass. The combined changed-source check's extension lint was interrupted by a task scratch-file addition during its compilation snapshot; rerunning that affected gate passed. All incremental source/test ratchets pass.
- Fresh independent review of the complete current-main candidate: **no P0/P1 findings**. Prior proofs retain their executing revision; unchanged-input evidence was reused, not relabeled as current-head CI.
- Initial [CI attempt 38014038205](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38014038205) exposed the repaired failures. Exact-head [CI attempt 38018303413](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38018303413) is now green for `fc79b69032ec71e3293213aebb28063b4a0c869f`, including the required CI/security gate. ClawSweeper completed review of that head with no findings. No CI rerun was requested.
- **Hosted Slack proof:** the corrected oracle counts only Chat Completions requests while retaining the exact three-turn/two-tool sequence and preview/final-message checks. Exact-head CI passes the preview case in 19.864 s and all 16 channel-progress cases in 357.31 s. The earlier local isolated Crabline inbound HTTP 500 remains a local fixture limitation, not passing local proof; hosted execution now verifies the changed oracle. No guard or assertion was disabled.
